name: mcp-checklist
description: MCP server for reusable checklists and dated runs of them: pass, fail, not applicable, and a sign-off. Checklists you build once and run many times, and the dated record of each run that somebody signs.

settings.name: mcp.zovo.one token
settings.description: A free anonymous token from https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/token, or your Pro key. One token is one data space, and it is refreshed for another 30 days on every write.

checklist.description: Checklists you build once and run many times, and the dated record of each run that somebody signs.
